title: [Decision] one lane, several execution PMs — option D, free-claim multi-seat: a second Claude Code account claims from the same domain:spec queue (protocol text in SKILL.md / core-rules / seat-post-protocol + a check-half-states H38 filter); A partition / B outlet-only kept as alternatives
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` execution PM seat, session `session_01Bz6hxDBqK62NP2W1LATvnt`, at the maintainer's direct request (2026-09-16, 「spec多账号并行应靠分区扩展,具体应该怎么做」). **Rewritten at 2026-09-16T09:39Z** on the maintainer's remark in the seat's chat 「18394 现在写的不是我们刚才讨论的方案啊,一个车道多个项目经理」: the proposal discussed and recommended is option **D — free-claim multi-seat** (several execution PMs on one lane); the earlier partition proposal is kept below as option A for the record. Decision card: the answer changes protocol text (governed), so it is the maintainer's; ⛔ not auto-adjudicated. The measurement comment 5694631271 stands; the 08:53Z ruling (5694758281) was withdrawn (5694774788); nothing has been dispatched on this card.

## 维护者速读

**事情**:spec 车道 `pm:queue` 95 张(objectstack)+ 15 张(objectui),近三天出口 9 / 9 / 3。协议现在规定「一座位一车道双射」:一个车道只能有一个 PM 账号在认领,第二个账号进不来。你要的是**一个车道多个项目经理**:各自认领、各自派 dev、各自复核落地,认领时不撞车。

**方案 D(推荐)= 自由认领多席**:同一个车道同时坐 N 个 PM 账号。每个 PM 一张座位贴(`[PM seat] domain:spec · seat 2`),认领评论多写一行 `Seat:`,派发前多读一次本车道其他席在飞卡的文件面(相交就串行或让行)。不切目录、不加标签、分诊不用改任何事。ui、devx 车道拿同一份改动直接可用。

**代价**:一张规则层 PR —— SKILL.md 三处「双射」句、互斥读数三/四改按席号过滤、同域在飞检查一句;core-rules 一行;seat-post-protocol 一行;`check-half-states.mjs` H38 按席号过滤 —— 等你批一次;每账号写量仍是 batch 3,不涨。objectui 那份 `check-half-states.mjs` 镜像要同步一次(#18290),不同步只是巡查在 objectui 板上误报,不挡认领。

**其它选项**:A = 按 `packages/spec/src/` 目录家族切两个分区,各一席,要分诊打分区标签,只对 spec 成立;B = 不改协议,只做出口修复(分诊在席、连续派、派发令要求发布散文附读数、语义卡 A/B 试档位)。

**你要做的**:回一个字。**D** = 本席立刻派 skills 车道 dev 改协议(约 1 小时),PR 四件套挂起等你批一次,批后第二个账号跑 `/pm-dispatch spec` 即可坐席;**A** / **B** 见上。

## Option D — free-claim multi-seat (recommended)

- **Seat posts**: one post per seat, titled `[PM seat] domain:X · seat N` (seat 1 keeps today's post); each body is single-writer with the four sections unchanged; the `pm:seat` index shows N rows per lane. Precedent in SKILL.md: 「车道可按仓分席(域×仓):忙时一个 domain 车道开多个按仓席位,闲时收归一席。分席各有独立座位贴与 claim 互斥;分席是名册状态,不改协议文本。」 — D changes the split axis from repo to seat number.
- **Mutex readings 1 / 2** (收班简报 / 开轮标记): per post, unchanged.
- **Mutex readings 3 / 4** (another session's `Claim:` on a lane card ⇒ self-exit): the claim comment gains a `Seat: domain:X#N` line and readings 3 / 4 filter to the same seat number. Without this every second seat self-exits on every fire — this and the in-flight check are the two lines D really changes.
- **Same-domain in-flight check**: before each dispatch the seat reads the lane's `pm:dispatched` cards' claim file faces (the candidate enumeration already reads the whole lane in one listing); an intersection ⇒ serial behind that PR or yield. Replaces 「日常同域批次选择不跑全局在飞检查,同域独立性由本域批次选择保证」.
- **Hot-file serial queue**: lives in the claims (`serial behind PR #N`), not on a shared post; each post's section lists only its own chains. The inherited ledger is per seat; the lane's job description stays in `references/lanes/X.md`.
- **Bijection clauses**: 「一座位一车道双射:域 X 谁管、PM Y 管什么,各恰好一个答案」 (SKILL.md 全体座位的不变量), 规则 4 「一人一车道双射」, 「每个 domain:* 与 repo:* 恰一张座位贴」 (座位贴协议), core-rules 「一座位一车道双射,每域恰一 PM」 → a PM manages exactly one lane; a lane is managed by a set of seats; one post per seat.
- **Patrol reader**: `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` H38 (a lane `Claim:` newer than the post's last event ⇒ post STALE) filters by seat number; H5 / H32 need no change. objectui's mirror copy follows through #18290.
- **Write volume**: one seat = one account = `batch` 3; N seats = N accounts; per-account volume unchanged (the reason `batch` 3→5 was rejected: 「容易封号」).
- **Lanes**: lane-agnostic. Roll-out: spec first (objectstack 95 + objectui 15 queued), then ui (objectui `domain:ui` 133) and devx (objectstack 63) with the same protocol text. Partition-by-directory (A) was spec-specific.
- **Cost**: ~7 protocol lines + one H38 filter + one claim line; one rules-layer PR (four-piece, one authorized APPROVED); dev ≈ 1 h; usable the same day.

## Option A — two seats by path family (kept for the record)

Labels `spec:core` / `spec:surface` set by triage from the fix's directory (core = `data/ shared/ kernel/ contracts/ system/ identity/ security/` + strictness ledger + `packages/spec/scripts/**` and spec-bound gates; surface = `ui/ automation/ ai/ api/ marketplace/ studio/ qa/ integration/`); `/pm-dispatch spec part:core|surface`; candidate query = `domain:spec` ∩ `spec:PART`; a second seat post per partition; cross-partition cards to the primary landing directory's seat; the mutex readings filter by partition label. Cost: one governed PR + a one-hour relabel of ~96 cards + a second session; spec-only; commits-per-directory readings in comment 5694631271.

## Option B — no protocol change; throughput fixes only

Triage seated; the spec seat dispatches continuously at `batch` 3 with p3 families folded; dispatch orders require a measured reading for every published sentence a diff changes; a tier A/B on semantic cards for two weeks. Cost: zero protocol text. Ceiling: one account's review time and write budget. (Compatible with D; the dispatch-order line is free and can be done regardless.)

- SKILL.md 入口与角色, 开轮互斥 readings 三/四 (「本车道 pm:dispatched ∪ pm:queue 卡最新非本 session 的 Claim: 评论」, 「state=CLOSED … 第一张卡的 Claim: session ID」) — the two readings D scopes to the seat.

## 四棱(对 D)

- **实际业务需求** — 实测:spec 12 天净增 34 张、近三天出口 9 / 9 / 3;ui 133、devx 63 同样积压。瓶颈是「一车道一账号」的写额度与复核时间,不是卡不够独立。
- **项目长远合理性** — D 与既有「分席」先例同构,只换分席轴;不加标签、不加跟踪器、不改分诊;A 只对 spec 成立,ui/devx 还要各自再切一次。
- **防 AI 犯错** — 撞车三道防线:认领原子写 + 回读(已有)、`Seat:` 行让互斥读数不误退、派发前读他席在飞文件面;H38 过滤让巡查不误报。文件面相交的卡走既有串行队,落地仍由合并队列串行。
- **创业阶段不扩散** — 一张 PR、零新标签、零新门禁、零新账号形态;先 spec 两席试一轮,验证 `Seat:` 行与 H38 后再开 ui / devx。
